traits.raw: ℹ️ Hymenium Attachment: Exposed on upper surface of the apothecium

traits.label: Stipe
traits.text: Slender, cream to pale yellowish

traits.label: Ecology
traits.text: Saprobic on fallen acorns, acorn cupules and other decaying nut shells, especially Quercus; also reported from Fagus, Corylus and Carpinus fruits; usually in small groups; late summer to autumn
traits.raw: 🌳🌰 Saprobic on fallen acorns, acorn cupules and other decaying nut shells, especially Quercus; also reported from Fagus, Corylus and Carpinus fruits; usually in small groups; late summer to autumn

traits.text: Apothecium ∅ ~0.5–4 mm

traits.label: Flesh
